_comment: v3.3 — Full Dify (no RAGFlow). Lean stack: Qdrant + Redis + Postgres + Dify + Frontend.

services.name: postgres
services.description: Native Postgres for Dify + Plugin Daemon.

services.name: qdrant
services.description: Qdrant vector store for Dify Knowledge Base (Hybrid Search).

services.name: dify-api
services.description: Dify Flask API — Chatflow brain + Knowledge Base.
arguments: uv run flask db upgrade && uv run flask run --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5001 --debug

services.name: dify-worker
services.description: Dify Celery Worker — background tasks: document indexing, embedding, mail.
arguments: uv run celery -A app.celery worker -P gevent -c 1 --loglevel INFO -Q dataset,generation,mail,ops_trace,app_deletion

services.name: dify-plugin-daemon
services.description: Dify Plugin Daemon v0.14+ — manages model plugins.
arguments: set -a && source runtime/ubuntu-stack/plugin-daemon.env && set +a && runtime/ubuntu-stack/bin/plugin-daemon/plugin-daemon-cli migrate && exec runtime/ubuntu-stack/bin/plugin-daemon/plugin-daemon-server

services.name: dify-web
services.description: Dify Next.js admin UI — Chatflow, KB, Model config.

services.name: chatbot-frontend
services.description: Napas Chatbot Next.js Frontend — chat UI with image rendering.
